reviews.review_description: Paid a deposit in August 2023 for a rooftop installation, but then found Sunface no longer answer phones nor emails.  Contacted Consumer Affairs who confirmed no response.  They also noted that Solar Quotes had paused the Sunface account in June 2023.  Sadly they hadn't updated the web site and we used their reccomendation as a basis for our purchase decision.

From first contact with Imran from Sunface Solar Launceston we had a pleasant no pressure experience and found him very professional, and excellent in taking the time explaining all the details to a pair of Solar novices like us.An installation date was given, deposit paid and the install done which was finished in 4-5 hours.(digital meter was fitted 2-3 years ago which sped up the install)The local tradesmen showed up on time and we couldn't ask for a better team to carry out the task!The whole job was very professional and a very tidy outcome was achieved in minimal time with the grid connection included.My wife and i were extremely impressed with the results and glad we chose  Sunface Solar for the job.Highly recommended, with great price and service! (prices varied a lot ! )A & E,  Launceston

Very impressed with the communication from the retailer (Sunface) when we asked questions through emails and phone calls. He was happy to answer everything and did so in a timely manner. The installation of our system went very well.The guys from GJ Electrical were onsite when they said they were going to be and had the whole system installed 4 hours later.Very professional and efficient with everything they did. Even removed all the packaging when they finished.

All companies SolarQuotes referred provided excellent customer service. We chose SunFace based on prompt installation of enhanced panels, larger and optimised inverter with remote diagnostics, 20/25 year warranty and competitive pricing. It was a very inviting combination.

Very disappointed with functionality of inverter and lack of followup from installer.If it functioned as intended the system would offer good value, as it is, it requires constant vigilance to reset it and force it into proper generation.The installation was prompt, efficient and clean

Imran provided excellent customer service. Was very prompt and efficient in handling our enquires.The installation team was very professional. We were quoted a time frame of 4 weeks and it was installed with the 4weeks.They also organised the meter upgrade. Very happy with their work.

We got three quotes but only Imran from Sunface Solar came to see us at our home. I did a lot of research about solar and found Imran's advice to be very accurate. Unfortunately we had to wait three months for the installation because they were very busy but everything went very well. Overall we are very pleased that we choose Sunface Solar.

One thing that irritates customers is when providers don't respond after signing the contract.Imran was our contact person and from the start he responded to evey call or message I've sent.The panels look great and the work is precise and neatly done.Highly recommended.Jan.
Quote was quick and inspected the place. Given good information and installed in a timely fashion.

The quoting was good, the installation  of the system was excellent although there were some issues that required to be worked out.Customer service  ie grid connection after system installation excellent!Three months into commissioning of the system very pleased.

I was quite wary prior re solar sales people but Imran was great to deal with from start to finish. No hard selling. He was was great to deal with.The Install of the soar panels was a seemless process - completed within 4 hours. The Conctractors were great to deal with.
Solar quote requested, Google map provided SunFace with the site images. Quote, one day, evaluate 3 others from your input; all more $.A very enjoyable experience.

System type:20 × 300watt Canadian Solar panels and5kw Fronius inverter.Configuration:10 panels facing East and 10 panels facing West.Date installed:21st October 2019.Place installed:ULVERSTONE - Tasmania.Contact:Imran - Tasmanian manager.Performance:In the 3 years to 20/10/2022(1096 days) the system has generated 21787 kw.This equates to 19:88kw daily average.Energy accounts comparisons:Aurora energy - 1/11/2018 - 27/10/2019$1335:59.1st energy  - 28/10/2019 - 24/10/2020$673:84.(A new smart metre was installed  on 30/01/2020 so we received no feed-in until this date.)1st energy  - 25/10/2020 - 1/11/2021$260:82(Does NOT include Tasmania winter energy suppliment of $125:60).1st energy  - 2/11/2021 - 26/10/2022$289:01(Does NOT include Tasmania winter bill buster discount of $119:00).Remarks/comments:When the system was installed told us we would average 20:0 kw per day.The system has averaged 19:88 kw over the 3 years of operation - which we are very happy with.We have found Imran very approachableand knowledgeable and would recommend Sunface Solar to anyone who is thinking of installing a solar system.

Lots of follow up communication prior to signing up and then nothing much. Installed in a timely manner. Installers were good but left metal filings and bits of debris on roof, which we had to get up and clean as we harvest rainwater off the roof. Registration of unit wasn't done properly and I had to follow up.

Sunface Solar provided a great quality system for a competitive price. They customised the installation to suit our property including some last minute changes on the day and the result is a very nice, highly productive installation. 34 panels on tilt up frames, with optimisers, consumption monitoring and hot water timers. We are producing ~ 90kw/h on a good day and couldn't be happier. Thankyou to Imran who provided excellent customer service and Jonathan plus team for the high quality installation & support.
The team took care of finance and installation.. very happy customer
Sales / quoting process was good.  Salesman was not pushy.Installation was on time, polite, tiday and punctual.  Had to re-schedule due to other issues and was never a problem.
The installation of my solar system was good and was on time. I am very pleased with the whole process. Would recommend Sunface to friends and family.

The salesman was very knowledgeable of the industry and the latest developments, and did not pressure us to spend more than necessary.The installers were very experienced and seemed to know exactly what they were doing. They turned up on time, answered all my questions, and took away all the packaging.It’s only been one day since the panels were installed, so I guess it will take a week or two before our electricity supplier contacts us after the paperwork is submitted by the installer.

We were lucky to get quotes from three different types of installer; an expensive and good system, a cheap one, and the third quote showed us a wide range of equipment and prices from which we were able to juggle the best compromise. Installation followed very soon and was done in one day - efficiently and tidy. Once installed, we had zero follow up until the bill was due to be paid.

The design and quotation process was well handled by Imran, who listened to what I wanted and designed an appropriate system. The system was very expensive, but that was mainly due to my insistence on Enphase microinverters and a Tesla battery.The installation was slow, partly because we had an inadequate line in from the road which had to be upgraded before the system could be commissioned and partly because the contracted installer was based 140 kms away which made each trip a big deal. So, even though the line was upgraded 5 days later, it was another month before the system was commissioned - very frustrating watching all those sunny days roll by with an inoperative solar system sitting in the roof.There were some other minor problems that had to be resolved, with a long delay each time, and the system wasn't completely functioning until 4 months after the initial quote.Having said that, I have to say also that I am very happy with the result. I have a 10.9 kW system facing east with a tilt of only 14 degrees (because that's the way the roof is) that produces 80 kWh of energy on a sunny day and 40 on a bright overcast day.Sunface Solar, through Imran, were always available to answer queries and handle complaints and I didn't receive a bill until everything was sorted to my satisfaction.
I have accepted the quote from Sunface Solar, but the installation is not possible until late January. I have paid a deposit of $720 and signed a contract.
Customer service is the worst ever experienced - no grid connection & they will not respond to emails or phone calls.Wry unhappy customer & have made complaint to Ombudsman

We’re super happy with the service we received from Sunface. Imran explained everything thoroughly and answered all the questions we had quickly. He also changed the system design on numerous occasions die to our indecision without fuss. The whole process ran smoothly and quicker and easier than we expected.The install team(GJ Electrical) were friendly and explained a lot of information throughout the installation and we’re neat and tidy.So far the system is performing great, even though our weather has been pretty average since the installation.

My main objective for the installation was to have a back up system in case of grid failure.Sunface were to install the system but when the installer arrived he explained that the battery system would not do the job. The panels were installed but with a different inverter.After a back and forth over the cost of the new system without battery backup I contacted Thomas Wolf Energy  and they installed a Tesla Powerwall ( within 2 weeks of contact )and also ran some of the solar panel conduit internally in the wall cavity as it was rather unsightly.So my recommendation in future  ( if anyone asks ) would be to buy the system off the installer as the sellers do not necessarily understand a hybrid system and the actual installation .From all 3 recomendations you gave me they all told me where they could place the components but on the day it was deemed by the installer to be not possible. So once more i think that a integrated seller / installer is the best way to goHope this helps

After a couple emails back and forth Sunface Solar was able to provide me with a detailed easy to understand quote. From us accepting the quote to the system being installed was only 2 weeks! Their installers where very professional and experienced. They had managed to place the inverter exactly where we wanted it in the garage. After installation Sunface Solar has been more then willing to answer any questions we have had. Will definitely be asking them to quote the second system when I eventually finish the shed.

Imran of Sunface Solar was a pleasure to deal with. He was very knowledgeable about the available options, and took time to explain the advantages of each of them.The installers communicated regularly about the progress of the installation, which was professionally carried out, and went extremely well.Imran's customer service was exemplary, making all the necessary arrangements on our behalf, and mading the whole process from start to finish effortless.
Imran is polite knowledgeable about solar and does not do a hard sell.The installation went smoothly including moving a TV aerial that was in the way.
Very professional, everything as advertised. All work done on time and any technical matters clearly explain by the reps. Very happy with everything.

Fantastic service, good choice of panels and inverters, very knowledgeable rep. Took the time to look at our power bill and Taylor our system to suit our power use. Explained differences between the panels and inverters and options too, will be looking to add batteries in the future

The three installers arrived on time at 8am and surprised me when they said they would be finished by 3pm. They worked continuously and only stopped when we gave them a well deserved coffee. The angle of the roof at 37 degrees was no problem. Matt the senior installer had arranged all the communication with Aurora Energy so when they left there was solar excess going to the grid and all we had to do was register for the SolarEdge App. I should add that they tidied up and left no debris around the place for which our dog is thankful. She will test taste new objects.There was a small error with the App but it was fixed within 48 hours of mentioning it to Imran the salesman. Imran was a non-pushy salesman whose advice to get optimisers on the Trina 370W panels has proved to be correct as we get partial shading around 9am and 3pm.So far (only installed a week ago) the 6.6kw 18 panel system has been producing just above 5.4kw in the middle of sunny days and around 33kWh over full sun days. For our electricity usage that would save us around $1000 a year off our power bills with the low 6.501c Feed in Tariff from Aurora Energy. Hence a payback of 7 years for the $7500 cost.Would happily recommend Sunface Solar to do an installation.
Imran, together with the Installers Sam and Egan were very professional & courteous.The resultant install went to plan and occurred on time and as quotedVery pleased with the overall experience

The initial idea of installing solar panels seemed nerve racking to us but Imran put our mind at ease and got the whole process running smoothly. Our queries were answered promptly and he catered to our needs efficiently.The installation guys did a fabulous job. The whole team worked in tandem and got the job completed without any delay. Would highly recommend Solarface !

My interaction with Sunface Solar was very easy and productive. The quoting process was smooth and they listened to what I asked for, and also made informed suggestions.The actual install was very smooth and efficient. The quality of the work is exceptional. All matters were discussed and I was informed of the process.Customer Service has been great, they basically fully organised the connection to the grid. They have been willing to discuss and work through any questions I had in relation to the install and the App usage.I would happily and confidently recommend Sunface Solar for a quality install.

Every step was organised well. Prompt with all of our queries.The installers worked hard all day.Our connection was immediate as we did not have to change the meter. The installers ran through the system with us.A follow up was made the next day to ask if we were satisfied with the work.Very pleased with the whole process.
The quote process was easy and installation a dream. Installer turned up on time and got the job done quickly and efficiently, even in poor weather! Very helpful and friendly, would recommend.

We highly recommend Sunface Solar.They are very professional and provided immediate answers ro all our questions.  Their communicate was clear and very helpful with making our decision about what system to go with.The installation was seamless with all the information we needed.  We benefited immediately and had a dramatic reduction in our monthly power costs.We have now had our home and business installed with solar power and are very happy with the savings and the professional services that have been provided.

Imran had some really great information, when we were discussing what we wanted. I really enjoyed the conversation.The original installation date got put back a week or two but when the day came they arrived on time, they pulled down the original system and installed the new one. The job looks neat and tidy the system is working great and we couldn’t be happier.

contacted others for quotes  ,ranged from a "ph interview " to "give me a deposit now..."Surprised that they all seemed reluctant to leave brochures of their products?We opted for better products and was willing to pay a little extra and found it worth while shopping around for the same products.Time will tell if we have made the right choice in the long run.
Installation went as planned.They organised everything as I they promised
Installation was good and very quick but have not received any written info on how system operates or how I can monitor if system operating correctly.
The quote process is very professional, system was installed by certified installer. Happy with the whole process. Highly recommended!

I was a little nervous about getting solar on our historic home. I can honestly say this is the most neat unobtrusive install I've ever seen.  Being able to get 3 quotes enabled us to form a sound decision about a product we knew nothing about. Imran from Sunface Solar is knowledgeable and accessible for any follow up queries.  We are generating more power than expected which is great to see. Overall this has been a great experience and I can highly recommend Solar Quotes and Sunface Solar. PS don't be like us and mock people who monitor their solar production because you will become those people!
I’m very happy and have been very very happy with the quoting process they were very punctual very neat very tidy they cleaned up after themselves thank you very much..
Great service and a great system, I highly recommend these guys if your thinking of installing a decent system at a decent price.
Found Imran at Sunface solar easy to work with and installation done on time installers worked tirelessly and done a great job.
The customer service from quote to the installation has been great. Real happy with our solar system and Sunface team.
Installation team was very efficient what they did. Whole installation process was quick and easy. I am very pleased with Sunface Team. Highly recommended

the guys turned up on time and ready to govariations to original plans were sorted and the installation was smooth.all cleaned up packed away well before the original estimated timevery professionalall queries and questions answered professionally and politelygrid connection is to be dealt with by tasnetworks
Great customer serviceGreat valueQuick installationGreat over all experienceDo recommend.
System installed and now waiting for electric company to complete the install. Customer service first rate.
Very happy with the installation .the guys were friendly and very professonal. Am happy to recomend  sunface .
The installer was a local Electrical company they was Prompt and tidy Done  a great job they Organized everything sunface was great to deal with as well new the Product inside and out.

Sales rep was very helpful and informative. Changes were discussed with a satisfactory outcome.Installers were punctual and tidied up afterwards. Problem was found in the ageing network system but was rectified.The whole process was done and dusted in a few hours.

I was very impressed with Waque  he answered all my questionsI was a bit disappointed when someone else followed upInstallation was very well done they were right on time very impressedWhen imram came to take me through the final process he was very goodHopefully I am pleased with the solar panels for a very long time

I have come across Sunface Solar randomly but I had great experience with their team. Team at Sunface had clear idea about different products available and what was best suited for m needs. They were happy to answer my questions and responded to my emails promptly.They offer best value for money in Tasmania. Sunface used quality products and used efficient and leading installers for me.I have referred Sunface to may of my friends and I am confident that they are doing a fantastic job.

Sales quote was very easy, personal, Imran explained everything clearly & precise. The installation went like clock work very happy. Excellent customer service Imran still willing to talk through any queries. Biggest decision for us was to still keep the panels discreet from the road side, Imran worked this out not only for the aesthetics but for maximum efficiency of the system, being a modern Container home this was so important.....awesome result.

The salesman that came to our home was very resourceful, organised and was able to answer all of our enquiries plus made suggestions on which solar panels was best for us.The 2 man installing our panels were polite and was able to answer any questions that we may have. They were also on time for the job and they also tidy up after themselves..
So pleased we went with these guys... just great service.
The whole process was quite smooth and for the most we where very happy

Good to deal with. From quote to installation. Inverter upgraded free of charge as was also given 2 extra panels in quote. Jonathan who overseen installation and wired the system up has a wealth of knowledge and made sure i qas gwtting the best savings by looking over my power bill pryor to setting it on what tarrif it needed. Highly recommended especially Jonathan for install. Bill has gone from $480 average to $110

Imran from Sunface Solar was very professional , efficient and polite to deal with. Everything went very smoothly and given I am in Sydney and the property in Tasmania I was very concerned as to whether this would be difficult to coordinate- it couldn’t have been easier and I was kept informed throughout the process
From start to finish a very professional company to deal with. Installation was very professionalWe have not received a bill since installation and are $200 in credit.Best money we have ever spent.
He was the only rep to visit, the others were giving a price but did not come & see us.Installation went great, very professional.Still waiting for grid connection, this is Christmas

The sales and quote process was professional, although I wasnâ€™t informed that it didnâ€™t include timer for hot water or the monitoring for all the aspects of the installation ( import and export graphs to the grid for example)The installation went as expected quick, polite,punctual but needs to pay attention to clean up the smaller items ie used cable ties and packaging.Customer service has been good and on going. Mainly to do with the wifi monitoring of the old upgraded system(Sungrow inverter)and the new system (Solar inverter)In conclusion I would not hesitate to recommend Sunface and this system to anyone wishing to go solar. The operation of both the old and new system is living up to what Sunface claimed and to my expectations. I could not be happier with the operation and the value for my dollars invested. The experience has been one of my better contract experience.

Thanks, Sunface Solar for helping me out. One of my Renesolar panels was damaged and the original company I used to get the panels were not helping at all. I asked whether you guys could find me an equivalent replacement and instead you found me an exact match and had it installed in days at a very reasonable cost. Your guys were helpful and efficient and the job was done in less than an hour. What a pleasure to deal with a service-oriented company for a change.Would recommend you to anyone who is looking for Solar panels of batteries and will discuss the option for a battery on our place next year.Thanks again for your efforts.
I was very impressed, they worked hard and the whole lot was installed in a little over 3 hours.Great job.I would heartily recommend Sunface to anyone.I assure them that they will be glad about it.
